{{Quote|Something's come up. I need to borrow Tycho and his B-wing. Maybe for just a few hours.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] requisitioning Tycho's B-wing.|<ref name="SoM" />}}
An '''A/SF-01 B-wing''' was piloted by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] the [[Battle of Mindor]].

==History==
In [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]]<ref>''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>, around the same time as the Battle of Mindor was commencing, Tycho Celchu piloted his B-wing to escort [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Cobra|personal shuttle]] to an unnamed [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] station in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] so that Calrissian could attempt to resolve the gridlocked negotiations between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. During these negotiations, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]] attempted to requisition Tycho and his B-wing to depart for [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] after she received a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] that led her to believe the Battle of Mindor was going poorly. 

Tycho was initially hesitant to go behind General Calrissian's back and take Princess Leia to Mindor, but when [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and the rest of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] agreed to help Leia, Tycho relented. With Leia acting as the B-wing's [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], Tycho piloted the starfighter to the [[Taspan system|Mindor system]] where they rendezvoused with the ''[[Lancer (freightliner)|Lancer]]'', one of the New Republic [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] engaged in the Battle of Mindor.<ref name="SoM" />
